hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -f tools/specs/hook_gate.py ]; then python3 tools/specs/hook_gate.py session-start --emit claude; fi
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -f tools/specs/hook_gate.py ]; then python3 tools/specs/hook_gate.py after-edit --emit claude; fi
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -f tools/specs/hook_gate.py ]; then python3 tools/specs/hook_gate.py after-edit --emit claude; fi
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -f tools/specs/hook_gate.py ]; then python3 tools/specs/hook_gate.py before-stop --emit claude; fi
{ root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && cd "$root" && [ -f tools/specs/hook_gate.py ] && python3 tools/specs/hook_gate.py turn-start --emit claude; } 2>/dev/null || exit 0
